Control quickhack · ◆ Quiet · DV10 · Cooldown 10 Rounds · 1 slot · Needs: Kerenzikov, Sandevistan or other speedware

Their speedware shuts off for 20 Rounds. If it was running, they lose its bonus now and take 1d6 to HP from the crash.

Interface + 1d10 vs DV10. 1,000eb (Very Expensive). Cyberpunk: The Unification Era, Core Rules Chapter 10.
